description:
Create an API key for the active organization (session only)
Requires a signed-in dashboard session, not another API key — an agent cannot mint its own first key this way. The full key is only ever returned once, in this response; store it immediately.

name.description: A label to tell keys apart, e.g. 'CI deploy key'.

scopes.description: manage ⊇ read ⊇ submit — a manage key satisfies every read- or submit-scoped call too.

name: api_keys_create
